method: Retain the preceding deterministic 200-entry sample and review the first English/Chinese pair of each entry for complete grammatical usage, relevant meaning, accurate translation and retained source metadata. All examples additionally pass length, count, uniqueness and phrase-limit checks. Reviewed by the coding assistant, not an independent human study. Dedicated split-pronunciation examples were separately reviewed.
